200.description:
One FCIA member record from its detail page: name, member-since date, description, printed address and structured address with coordinates, telephone, website, service areas served, named contacts (no e-mail: members-only on the site) and accreditation badges. Accepts the numeric location_id from a search result or a pasted member URL. An unknown id is not_found.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accreditations` | object | Accreditation badges the directory renders on the record (img.accredited class names fmapprovedLogo, ulapprovedLogo, iasaccreditedLogo). false means the badge is not shown. |
| `address` | object |  |
| `address_text` | string | 'Our Address' line exactly as printed. |
| `contacts` | object[] |  |
| `description` | string |  |
| `latitude` | number |  |
| `location_id` | string |  |
| `longitude` | number |  |
| `member_since` | string | ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) parsed from the site's 'Member Since: MM/DD/YYYY'; null when the page prints none. |
| `name` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `service_areas` | string[] | States, provinces or countries the member lists under Service Areas, as printed. |
| `source_url` | string | Canonical detail page that answered. |
| `telephone` | string | Company telephone as printed. |
| `website` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

members.description: Firestop systems play a critical role in maintaining the integrity of a building’s passive fire protection strategy, yet they are often underappreciated or misapplied in design specifications. For architects, understanding the importance of specifying firestop correctly is essential to ensuring life safety, code compliance, and the overall resilience of the building. Missteps in firestop specification can compromise compartmentation strategies, increase liability risks, and result in costly remediation during construction or later in the building’s life cycle. If a fire breaks out at a commercial property, commercial firestopping can compartmentalize or confine the fire and keep it from spreading through the entire building. At Division 7, Inc., our highly trained professionals understand how important commercial-grade firestopping is for protecting lives and property. Division 7, Inc. provides quality firestop and insulation systems by offering a complete range of commercial and residential insulation services that can be individually tailored to your specific needs. The professionals at Division 7, Inc. will help you develop a complete system with the best materials to address your concerns, whether they be energy efficiency, environmentally-friendly materials, firestopping, acoustics, fireproofing, budget or all of the above.
members.name: Division 7, Inc.

200.description:
List FCIA members matching one or more directory filters (AND semantics): service_area (US state, Canadian province, Middle East or North America country key), region, accreditation, member_type and barrier_management. The site returns the whole result set on one page ('Showing N Records'); this function pages it client-side with page/page_size. A filter combination with no members returns total_records 0 and an empty members array.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `members` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accreditations` | object | Accreditation badges the directory renders on the record (img.accredited class names fmapprovedLogo, ulapprovedLogo, iasaccreditedLogo). false means the badge is not shown. |
| `address` | object | null when the page has no map marker for this record. |
| `address_text` | string | Address line exactly as printed on the card. |
| `branches` | object[] |  |
| `contacts` | object[] |  |
| `description` | string | Member-written description paragraph(s), whitespace-collapsed; null when the card has none. |
| `detail_url` | string | Canonical member detail page. |
| `latitude` | number |  |
| `location_id` | string | Directory location id; input to get_member. |
| `longitude` | number |  |
| `name` | string |  |
| `services` | string[] | Bullet items the member lists on the card (services, specialties, memberships); empty when none. |
| `website` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
